`Path.rglob` is the pathlib method that does a recursive glob. It behaves as if the pattern were prefixed with `**/`, and `**` components are always recursive in pathlib. `fnmatch.fnmatch` case-normalizes both the name and the pattern using `os.path.normcase`. The case-sensitive alternative is `fnmatchcase`.
